title: SURE-VQA: Systematic Understanding of Robustness Evaluation in Medical VQA Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the relative robustness of Vision-Language Models by training on medical data (chest X-rays and questions) from male patients and testing out-of-distribution (OoD) on female patients.
Evaluating relative robustness by training models on medical data from white patients and testing out-of-distribution on patients from other ethnicities.
Evaluating relative robustness by training models on medical data from patients over the age of 60 and testing out-of-distribution on patients under the age of 40.
